Hey folks, Chris here!

Patch notes are below, but first I want to thank everyone who has left a Steam forum post, review, and shared your bugs and logs with us on Discord. Please consider joining to help us keep improving the game:
If you haven't already, also PLEASE consider leaving a review for BIG HOPS!

Now that the game has been out a while, people finding it decide to buy based on the general sentiment from reviews and you can really help us out there. Because it's a long game played over multiple sessions we don't get as many reviews even though a lot of people have bought and are enjoying the game.
Anyway, onto the update! This is our biggest patch yet with a handful of highly requested features and a ton of fixes:
Higher framerates are now supported with consistent game feel at different FPS

Cappler’s Conspiracy is a new 2+ hour photography game hidden inside BIG HOPS. You’ll meet a conspiracy theorist Owl named Cappler who needs your help exploring some weird ideas. He’ll send you on jobs to prove (or disprove) the existence of Aliens, Ghosts, Mole People, and more. For your efforts you’ll be rewarded with dozens of new camera filters, lenses, and a special Sky Shifter gadget. To find Cappler and get to work, keep an eye out for Cappler’s special symbol hidden throughout the many worlds in BIG HOPS.
Read more here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1221480/partnerevents/preview/519741583516501840

Hi, Chris here!

Thanks to everyone out there who has played BIG HOPS and especially those who have given us feedback. We appreciate everyone taking the time to review the game! We take all the criticism really seriously and are committed to improving the game as much as possible. Today we're taking a BIG STEP in that direction with the QOL Update. Here's the big stuff:
Completionist Tablet

Once you successfully rebuild the Airship and go inside, you'll find a new gadget that will help find the rest of those collectibles you're missing out on. Thanks for your patience on this- being totally honest we were surprised just how much players have connected with BIG HOPS as a collect-a-thon.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/0656fef574458ce0bde279fad70ecff1daa0aaca.png"]
Keyboard Rebinds

This was the biggest missing feature at launch in my opinion. We had some negative reviews focused on this and they were fair. There's a new button in the settings menu to let you rebind your keyboard input. For controllers we're still relying on Steam Input and recommend you use Steam's workflow.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/d9d3dce40f6b576e43a32fd4898228f6fb57b2ec.png"]
Hold to Skip Dialogue

Our speedrunners were loud and clear that mashing buttons to get through dialogue quickly was threatening to give them a RSI. We want speedrunning Hops to be fun and only slightly painful so we've added a new settings menu option to allow holding down a button to skip dialogue. Note this will only appear after you've beaten the game on any save.
New Trinkets

You'll notice there are a handful of new Trinkets in the rotation now. Pretend you don't see those for now as they're meant to be a part of our upcoming free Photography DLC. As far as QOL features go there is one new Trinket focused on that: 'Hat Stays On' makes it so your hat won't fall off when bonking into walls. Enjoy!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450754/92f219830a509fe2373b1d77dd1be0cfa76f8ed8.png"]

Last thing I'll mention: we're hard at working on Uncapped Framerate! Progress is going well, but we're still figuring out how to make this change without impacting our console versions. Expect that update in the next month.
Cheers,
Chris Wade
Director @ Luckshot Games
